question: What consequence follows from plunging into the waters at Prayāga or Kubja-tīrtha?
premises: Ritual plunging at sacred fords has spiritual effects.
Rebirth can be avoided through such acts.
inference: Having plunged at Prayāga or Kubja-tīrtha, one is not born again.
plain_english: Having plunged at Prayāga or at Kubja-tīrtha, one is not born again.
